fake_model_profile: fake model: 2000 ms to first token, 10 tokens/s, 75 tokens (about 10 s per run, measured on the NVIDIA ultra model on 2026-10-28)
note: Same method as load-baseline.json but with latency near the NVIDIA development model: first token 0.9 to 16 s (typically 1.4 to 2 s), 5 to 25 chunks/s, a typical 150-word answer in 7 to 17 s. Steps of 90 s, 30 more users each, 300 Keycloak test users, think time 6 s, token budget raised to 10M. Load generator and stack share one 4-CPU host. The real model was not load tested: the free NVIDIA key allows 40 requests per minute (about 0.67 runs/s), so it would have measured the key, not the platform. Real-model results may differ in either direction. Failure mode: 503 too_many_streams (APP_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS=100 per replica). Not hosted capacity.
